draft_policy: Skip the Full Regression decision job while the pull request is draft.
synchronize_policy: Every synchronize event for a non-draft pull request creates a new exact candidate and cancels the previous in-progress Full Regression decision for that pull request.
concurrency_policy: One Full Regression decision run per pull request or manual candidate; cancel-in-progress is true.

risk_policy.preliminary_source: TEST_LEVEL_PROVISIONAL marker in pull-request body; missing marker fails closed to L
risk_policy.delta_source: complete base SHA to exact candidate SHA diff
risk_policy.decision: final level is max(preliminary, delta); automatic downgrade is forbidden

required_authority_behavior: Every non-draft candidate still enters the Full Regression decision workflow. The fail-closed risk classifier decides whether the eleven F7-03 authorities are required. Final level L dispatches and aggregates all eleven authorities on the exact candidate SHA. Final level S or M records a green risk-authorized bypass; F7-02 remains the merge authority for those lower levels. A manual Full Regression dispatch always forces L.
